tools.name: mnemos_status
tools.description: Free. Live engine status: mode, watchlist, scan freshness, scorecard summary. Annotation basis: readOnlyHint=True (reads current state, mutates nothing), idempotentHint=True (repeated calls are equivalent reads), destructiveHint=False, openWorldHint=True (reflects live external market state).

tools.name: mnemos_astra_scorecard
tools.description: Free. Public methodology and prospective signal observations. Not user P&L. Annotation basis: readOnlyHint=True (reads a published scorecard, mutates nothing), idempotentHint=True, destructiveHint=False, openWorldHint=True.

tools.name: mnemos_decisions
tools.description: Paid (x402, 0.001 USD). Returns the MNEMOS ensemble's latest decision output — the current decision set produced by the engine's signal modules. Takes no inputs besides the caller's payment_signature; without a valid payment proof the call returns the route's 402 payment requirements. Read-only: it

tools.name: mnemos_options_cached
tools.description: Paid (x402, 0.001 USD). Returns the cached options radar and anomaly intelligence from the most recent stored scan — the options activity and anomalies the desk has already computed, served without triggering a new scan. tools.name: mnemos_options_scan
tools.description: Paid (x402, 0.001 USD). On-demand fresh options-radar scan. Annotation basis: readOnlyHint=False because each call triggers a new scan rather than reading a stored result; idempotentHint=False because repeated calls can return different results and incur a new charge.
